## Editor integrity checklist

- [ ] I tested that raw Markdown remains correct.
- [ ] I tested undo/redo if editor behavior changed.
- [ ] I tested cursor/selection boundaries if Live Preview changed.
- [ ] I considered IME/CJK input if text composition is affected.
- [ ] I did not copy incompatible code from a reference project.
